name: @latticekit/example-instrument
description: INSTRUMENT — a gallery exhibit. Sound with no files: a board that shows the synthesis as it plays.
$comment: Seven of nine, and this is the exhibit whose subject is `@latticekit/audio`. Nothing is loaded: every note is oscillators built at runtime, and the picture is `Audio.onScheduled`'s VoicePlan rather than an AnalyserNode. `sim` and `persist` are absent because a hall of pipes has no economy and nothing outlives the tab.
